meta.name: understand-chat
meta.description: Use when you need to ask questions about a codebase or understand code using a knowledge graph

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过知识图谱问答理解代码库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速理解不熟悉的代码库或审查代码逻辑。
copy.tagline_en: Understand codebases through knowledge graph Q&A
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand unfamiliar code or review code logic.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会读取项目中的知识图谱文件，回答关于代码库的问题。它会搜索相关节点、连接和层次，给出基于图谱的答案。
howto.when: 当用户询问代码库相关问题，且项目根目录存在 `.understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json` 文件时触发。

say.text: 这个项目中 `main.py` 文件的功能是什么？
解释一下 `UserService` 类依赖哪些模块。
say.note: Claude 会查找相关边，展示依赖关系。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude reads the knowledge graph file in the project and answers questions about the codebase. It searches for relevant nodes, edges, and layers to provide graph-based answers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks a question about the codebase and the file `.understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json` exists in the project root.

say_en.text: What is the purpose of the `main.py` file in this project?
say_en.note: Claude will search the knowledge graph for nodes related to main.py and answer.

say_en.text: Explain which modules the `UserService` class depends on.
say_en.note: Claude will find relevant edges showing dependencies.
